summary: Four matched fine-tuning runs completed. Adding the reviewed outdoor crops did not consistently improve development scene detection over matched controls and regressed the 67-frame blue results versus the incumbent.

arms: 21 reviewed Astek crops, each repeated four times
experiment.checkpoint_comparison: fixed final latest.keras, not validation-selected best checkpoint

key_results.training_target_diagnostic: All models, including the incumbent, cover all 13 reviewed training targets at IoU >=0.5 through full search and selection. The red crop 14 error is fixed in both admit runs but also in control48. This is training diagnostic evidence, not generalization.

interpretation: Adding easy blue crops did not target the remaining scene-level failures. Gains on the 62-frame panel also occur in controls, so they cannot be attributed to the new data. Panels overlap and were previously inspected; do not pool them as independent qualification data.
next_work: Keep the new source and labels available, but focus additional training/retooling on representative difficult blue scenes and detector-shaped regions rather than more repetitions of already-correct crops. Fresh held-out real scenes and isolated live Pi qualification remain required.
